prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Green Party Manifesto 2019 – Summary (≤500 words)

Core vision
- Urgent response to climate and ecological emergency, democratic renewal and social justice.
- Green New Deal (GND): a 10‑year plan to reach net‑zero UK emissions by 2030 while tackling inequality; >£100bn a year public investment plus additional UBI funding.

Green New Deal priorities
- Energy: rapid rollout of renewables (around 70% of electricity from wind by 2030), community energy, doubled grid capacity, expanded storage; end fossil fuel subsidies; rising Carbon Tax to make coal, oil and gas unviable; ban fracking; no new nuclear; greater interconnection with Europe.
- Housing: insulate every home by 2030; deep retrofit 1m homes/year; 1m households/year get rooftop renewables; heat pumps/heat networks replace gas; all rentals to EPC A by 2030; 100,000 new Passivhaus-standard social homes/year; planning to favour renovation/reuse.
- Transport: make public transport cheaper than cars; electrify main rail lines, reopen routes, devolve franchises, public ownership within 10 years; £2.5bn/year for cycleways and footpaths; cancel HS2 and all new road capacity; end sale of new petrol/diesel vehicles by 2030; nationwide EV charging; Frequent Flyer Levy; ban flight ads; default 20mph in residential areas; Vision Zero.
- Industry/circular economy: UK manufacturing for clean tech; £2bn/year for skills; regional mutual banks; right to repair and 10‑year warranties; ban most single‑use plastics; carbon capture for steel/cement; Carbon Tax covers industrial emissions.
- Food, farming & forestry: 10‑year transition to agroecology; refocused subsidies, secure tenancies; 700m trees; restore hedgerows; halve pesticides, ban most harmful; GM moratorium; right to food; clear eco/welfare labelling; encourage “less but better” meat/dairy (phased levy with revenues recycled to farmers); urban food growing; rewilding; flood prevention via nature-based solutions.
- Incomes: Universal Basic Income phased in (adult £89/week; pensioners £178/week; supplements for disability, lone parents and children; Housing Benefit retained for current recipients); no one worse off.

Democracy and Europe
- People’s Vote with Greens campaigning to remain; reform EU for transparency, social rights, climate leadership and humane refugee policy.
- UK democratic reform: proportional voting for all elections; elected second chamber; votes at 16; state funding of parties; lobbying transparency; Digital Bill of Rights; citizens’ assemblies; devolve powers and funding to councils; Carbon Chancellor, annual Carbon Budget; Future Generations Act.

Public services and quality of life
- NHS: +£6bn/year (rising to 2030), end internal market/privatisation, community health centres, mental health parity, free contraception and PrEP.
- Education: +£4bn/year; scrap high-stakes testing/Ofsted; formal schooling from 6; climate/nature education; restore arts/sport; abolish tuition fees and write off £9k‑era debt; expand FE/adult learning.
- Work and housing justice: Living Wage £12 (incl. 16–21s); gig economy rights; 10:1 pay ratio cap; 35 hours/week free childcare from 9 months; rent controls, end no‑fault evictions; community-led housing.

Rights, justice, drugs, animals
- End “hostile environment”, close detention centres, humane migration system; misogyny as hate crime; gender-based violence strategy; trans self‑ID and “X” passport marker.
- Halve prison population via prevention, restorative justice, youth services; community policing.
- Replace prohibition with regulated, health‑led drug policy (prescription heroin, regulated cannabis, minimum unit pricing for alcohol).
- Animal welfare: recognise sentience; ban hunting, live exports, factory farming practices and most animal testing; end badger cull; stronger transport/welfare rules; Commission on Animal Protection.

Nature
- Ecocide law; stronger protections for Green Belt/AONB/SSSI; right to roam (as in Scotland); peatland restoration; 30% of UK waters fully protected by 2030; urban greening.

Tax, spend and funding
- Operational spending +£141.5bn/year funded by: rising Carbon Tax (~£76.7bn), merged/simplified income and wealth taxes (~£21.7bn), Corporation Tax to 24% (~£12bn), bank taxes, anti‑avoidance, legalised drug taxes; offset by VAT cuts for leisure and small‑business NI relief.
- Capital investment £94.4bn/year via borrowing (low rates; GND expected to crowd in ~£50bn private investment/year).
- Savings by cancelling Trident, HS2, new roads/airport expansion, Help to Buy; end NHS internal market.
- International aid to 1% of GNI; end arms export promotion; promote global climate justice; push EU carbon border adjustments; new international “ecocide” law and protections for Arctic/Antarctic/Amazon.
